_doc: The quality-mode card: Standard, Premium, Ultra and Hybrid replace the old per-vendor VIDEO MODEL question (F-QM-1). mode_prices is the one price table the card, the gate and the cost estimate read. A KIE credit is $0.005.

shot_field_rules.picture_mode: one-picture | two-picture | nine-picture | lip-sync (the Shot Router's four routes, 3E.1). Every clip is image-to-video from its own checked keyframe; text-to-video is refused (N-32). 'two-picture' only where the live registry shows one request accepting both first and last pictures.
shot_field_rules.picture_mode_reason: plain words: why this route was used for this shot
shot_field_rules.reference_image_ids: list of this run's own reference or keyframe picture ids used, never a URL copied from another run
shot_field_rules.look_drifted: boolean: the style check found the take away from the run's locked look
shot_field_rules.video_model: the registry model id the shot was made with (the run owner's choice, N-12)
shot_field_rules.max_resolution: the resolution cap this shot was made under: one of 720p, 768P, 1080p, 2K, 4K

lipsync.note: The lip-sync model is fixed: OmniHuman 2.0 on every run, no alternative, no backup (3C.1a). It is not a card choice and never appears as one.

modes.label: Standard
modes.description: MiniMax H3 at 768P; one start picture per moving shot

modes.label: Premium
modes.description: MiniMax H3 at 2K; one start picture per moving shot

modes.label: Ultra
modes.blurb: 4K pictures and shots, when a model can
modes.description: a live-registry model that advertises 4K; shown, never faked when none does

modes.label: Hybrid
modes.blurb: best value everywhere, finer detail on the shots that matter
modes.description: Standard route for every shot, Premium (2K) on the shots the Shot Router marks as story turns

ultra.note: priced from the live registry model Ultra resolves to; ULTRA_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE when none qualifies
